name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1499: A browser is now a GUEST until a human claims it. Ownership is claimed by clicking a button and by nothing else - never inferred from the platform string, the hostname, or the presence of bare keys, because a bare d2r_rwMade holding 99 entries is what the seed re-mints on any Mac. The owner keeps the exact keys he has always had, so the migration moves nothing: it is a single pointer write. An unclaimed load resolves guest, suppresses every owner seed, and writes no bare account key at all. Verified end to end: a new browser reads 0/0/0 in its own I-namespace with the claim banner up and zero bare keys written, and one click brings 99/243/108 back on the bare keys.
